notes.title: Co-op, Color, and Convenience Update (v1.4)
notes.content:
[h1]BIG NEWS![/h1]
[h3]Super-Spatial has just received a major update adding new content and features, reworking UI, adding controller support, and even integrating local co-op! Play Super-Spatial with a friend or family and explore the vast universe together![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43861774/33b3eba76c33c22c3117340eb104692d09f7ab09.png[/img]

[h1]Change log[/h1]
[h2]New Features![/h2]

[h3]Play-style changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Local co-op 
[*] Controller support
[*] Full tutorial
[*] Steam achievements integration
[/list]

[h3]Added generation:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Water planet type
[*] Habitable planet type
[*] Alien structures with readable text
[*] Planet day-night cycles
[/list]

[h3]Added buildings:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Oxygen generator
[*] Painting machine
[*] Warp portal
[*] Combustion generator
[*] Glass
[*] Staircase
[*] Ladder
[*] Weighted trapdoor
[*] Door
[/list]

[h3]Added items/containers:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Crate
[*] Translation upgrade
[*] Machine frame
[*] Refined plasmonite
[*] Plasmonite core
[*] Advanced warp core
[/list]

[h3]Other changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Sounds overhauled
[*] Planets can now be selected in scanner to view data like planet type and material density
[*] Recipe menu reworked to be more user-friendly
[*] Steel plates now have additional placing options
[*] Individual planet surfaces no longer finite.
[*] Research progress can now be seen on scanner
[*] "Win" condition changed
[*] Save system reworked and optimized
[*] Added multiple save slots
[*] Entering pause menu does not stop time
[*] Player has indicator on helmet for when paused
[*] New title screen
[*] Better indicator for when oxygen is running low
[/list]

Fixed known issues:
[list]
[*] Fullscreen mode exits when creating new game
[*] Scanner zoom flips orientation of planets
[*] Button prompts incorrectly triggered
[*] Encountering errors when saving sometimes spawned player 'outside' ship
[*] Items fall through world when at high velocity and hitting a concave corner of a planet surface
[*] Sun position on scanner has brief incorrect position when enabling zoom on scanner
[*] Text on scanner enlarged when zooming
[*] On some frames items could not be picked up due to culling, sometimes leading to clicking multiple times to pick up an item
[*] Compression on low quality settings made world surface visuals generate incorrectly
[/list]
